summary: Yes, the head to head count is in the US Constitution. I think what @downes meant when "counting isn't important" it meant more "it isn't as good as scientific modeling that did not exist in 1782" but US courts use strict textual interpretation. #el30 #mb
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Yes, the head to head count is in the US Constitution. I think what @downes meant when "counting isn't important" it meant more "it isn't as good as scientific modeling that did not exist in 1782" but US courts use strict textual interpretation. #el30 #mb
